description: Serverless-only task options: USER_TASK_MANAGED_INITIAL_WAREHOUSE_SIZE and SERVERLESS_TASK_MAX_STATEMENT_SIZE are refused on a task that names a WAREHOUSE (at CREATE and at ALTER), TARGET_COMPLETION_INTERVAL has its own sentence naming the task in full, while USER_TASK_MINIMUM_TRIGGER_INTERVAL_IN_SECONDS is legal on a warehouse task. The rule does not fire on warehouse assignment or UNSET; a serverless task accepts every option in either spelling and lists no warehouse; and the stored settings come back through SHOW PARAMETERS IN TASK (TASK level for what the task set, a blank level and the default for what it left alone) while TARGET_COMPLETION_INTERVAL is a SHOW TASKS column rather than a parameter. Converted 1:1 from features/ServerlessTaskTest (now retired). Each test creates its own sink table and warehouse and drops the account-level warehouse.

steps.sql: CREATE TASK m1 WAREHOUSE = srv_wh USER_TASK_MANAGED_INITIAL_WAREHOUSE_SIZE = 'XSMALL' SCHEDULE = '60 MINUTE' AS INSERT INTO srv_sink VALUES (1)

error.messageContains: Cannot set USER_TASK_MANAGED_INITIAL_WAREHOUSE_SIZE on a non-serverless task.
